title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
slides: TikTok just made impulse buys one click away
Its AI assistant suggests products based on your watch history
But the assistant may recommend items you never searched for
You'll see 'buy now' buttons without leaving the video
Next time you scroll, ask: who profits from your impulse?
thread_text:
1. One‑Click Impulse Buys

TikTok's new AI assistant turns your watch history into a checkout button. You never search—it just suggests.

2. The AI Watches You

It recommends products based on every pause and rewatch. Your behavior becomes a shopping list.

3. Suggestions You Never Asked For

The assistant may push items you never searched for, widening the net beyond your intent.

4. Buy Without Leaving

'Buy now' buttons appear right in the video. No app switch, no friction—just tap and pay.

5. Who Profits From Your Scroll?

Next time you open TikTok, ask: is this recommendation for me, or for their revenue? Check your last impulse buy.

instagram.caption:
TikTok will suggest products based on your watch history, even items you never searched for.

The AI shopping assistant reads every pause and rewatch, then turns that behavior into recommendations.

A "buy now" button sits inside the video, so checkout happens without leaving the feed. 🛒

If you post content, your viewers can now buy mid-scroll, which shifts how you'd ever link or promote a product. 👀

Next time a recommendation pops up, ask: 🧠 is this for me, or for their revenue?
